summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of the assignment of all receivables it and its subsidiary held against Amazonas Energia, receiving R$ 554.1 million (subject to adjustment) and a call option for a minority stake. This is a routine operational update regarding a prior agreement, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing closes the transaction. Risk-arb angle: none; this is a debt settlement, not an M&A event.
